title: 第十六章 一招破敌全场哗然第十五章 你根本就不知道什么叫做可能
slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 初赛第一轮结束，一百二十八名胜者晋级。
杨卤的名字赫然在列，旁边标注着“胜”字，格外扎眼。
围观弟子们看着告示栏上那个名字，表情一个个都跟吃了苍蝇似的难受。没人想到杨卤真能赢，更没人想到他会赢得那么轻松——全程就用了一招凝星缚加一掌，就把祝山打下了擂台。
“肯定是运气！祝山轻敌了！”
“对对对，下一轮他就没这么好的运气了！”
“下一轮他对的是陈武！陈武可是二星灵王入灵境，和杨卤同境界，总不会也翻车吧？”
陈武，二星灵王入灵境，内门弟子中排名中游，主修近战，以一手“破山掌”闻名。他的实力在宗门内不算顶尖，但胜在稳健，从不轻敌。
这种对手，按理说不会犯祝山那种低级错误。
很快，第二轮开始了。
海富长老站在擂台上，翻看名册，朗声道：“下一组——杨卤，对阵陈武！请两位弟子上台！”
话音刚落，广场上再次沸腾起来。
所有人的目光都投向擂台方向，没想到第一场就是杨卤。
期待着一场“正名之战”——他们急需看到杨卤被打败，好证明之前的胜利只是运气。
陈武率先走上擂台。他是个粗狂的汉子，身材中等，面容沉稳，眼神坚毅。
他没有像祝山那样放狠话，而是直接走到擂台中央，朝杨卤拱了拱手：“请。”
简洁，干脆，不给杨卤任何嘴炮的机会。
杨卤也踏上擂台，回了一礼：“请。”
海富长老确认双方准备就绪，大手一挥：“开始！”
陈武率先发动进攻。他没有像祝山那样一上来就猛冲猛打，而是先拉开距离，绕着杨卤缓缓游走，寻找破绽。
他的步伐稳健，呼吸均匀，一看就是个经验丰富的老手。
台下的弟子们纷纷点头：“陈武果然稳，不像祝山那么冒进。”
“这种稳扎稳打的打法，杨卤那点花招就没用了！”
“等着看吧，陈武肯定能逼出他的真本事！”
擂台上，陈武游走了几圈，确认杨卤的防守没有明显破绽后，突然加速，右脚猛地蹬地，身形如箭般朝杨卤冲去！
一掌推出，掌风呼啸！
“破山掌！”
这一掌势大力沉，带着凌厉的星力波动，直取杨卤胸口。
杨卤眼睛微微一眯，没有硬接，而是侧身一让，让陈武的掌风贴着他的衣角掠过。
陈武一掌落空，毫不气馁，立刻变招，掌势回转，横扫杨卤腰侧！
杨卤再次后撤半步，堪堪躲开。
陈武连续抢攻，一掌接一掌，招招相连，攻势如同潮水一般连绵不绝。
他的掌法沉稳老辣，力道控制得极好，每一掌都带着恰到好处的劲道，既能给对手造成威胁，又不至于因为用力过猛而露出破绽。
台下的弟子们看得兴奋不已：“好！陈武压着他打！”
“杨卤只能躲，根本不敢接招！”
“对对对，就是这样，把他逼到擂台边缘去！”
然而，擂台上真实的情况，却和围观弟子们看到的完全不同。
陈武越是进攻，心中越是惊骇。
他已经连续打了三十多掌，每一掌都是他擅长的破山掌法，力道、角度、时机都拿捏得恰到好处。可不管他怎么打，杨卤总能在最后一刻躲开，身法轻盈得像一片落叶，明明就差那么一点就能打中，却总是差那么一点。
这种感觉，就像是在追一个永远追不上的影子。
更让陈武心惊的是，杨卤从头到尾都没有出手攻击，只是单纯地在躲闪。
content_en:
The first round of the preliminary round ended, and one hundred and twenty-eight winners advanced.
Yang Lu's name was clearly listed, with the word "win" written next to it, which was particularly eye-catching.
The disciples who were watching looked at the name on the bulletin board, and their expressions felt as if they had eaten flies. No one thought that Yang Lu could really win, and no one thought that he would win so easily - he only used one move of Star Condensation and one palm to knock Zhu Shan off the ring.
"It must be luck! Zhu Shan underestimated the enemy!"
"Yes, yes, he won't be so lucky in the next round!"
"He will face Chen Wu in the next round! Chen Wu is a two-star spiritual king who has entered the spiritual realm. He is in the same realm as Yang Lu, so he won't fall over too, right?"
Chen Wu, a two-star spiritual king, entered the spiritual realm. He was ranked in the middle among the inner disciples. He majored in close combat and was famous for his "Mountain-Breaking Palm". His strength is not at the top within the sect, but his victory lies in his stability and he never underestimates his opponents.
It stands to reason that this kind of opponent would not make stupid mistakes like Zhu Shan's.
Soon, the second round began.
Elder Haifu stood on the ring, looked at the roster, and said loudly: "The next group - Yang Lu, facing Chen Wu! Invite two disciples to come on stage!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the square started to boil again.
Everyone's eyes were turned to the direction of the ring, but they didn't expect that Yang Lu would be the first one.
Looking forward to a "battle to clear their name" - they urgently need to see Yang Lu defeated to prove that the previous victory was just luck.
Chen Wu took the lead on the stage. He is a rough man, of medium build, with a calm face and resolute eyes.
He did not say harsh words like Zhu Shan, but walked directly to the center of the ring and raised his hand to Yang Lu: "Please."
Be concise and straightforward, not giving Yang Lu any chance to talk.
Yang Lu also stepped onto the stage and saluted in return: "Please."
Elder Haifu confirmed that both parties were ready and waved his hand: "Start!"
Chen Wu took the lead in launching the attack. He did not rush in and fight like Zhu Shan did. Instead, he first distanced himself and slowly walked around Yang Lu, looking for flaws.
His steps are steady and his breathing is even, and he looks like an experienced veteran at first glance.
The disciples in the audience nodded one after another: "Chen Wu is really stable, not as aggressive as Zhu Shan."
"With this steady and steady style of play, Yang Lu's tricks are useless!"
"Just wait and see, Chen Wu will definitely be able to force him to show his true abilities!"
On the ring, Chen Wuyou walked around for a few times and after confirming that there were no obvious flaws in Yang Lu's defense, he suddenly accelerated, kicked the ground with his right foot, and rushed towards Yang Lu like an arrow!
Push out with one palm, the palm wind roars!
"Shattering Mountain Palm!"
This palm was powerful and heavy, with fierce star power fluctuations, and it hit Yang Lu's chest.
Yang Lu narrowed his eyes slightly, and instead of forcefully receiving the blow, he stepped aside, letting the wind of Chen Wu's palm brush against the corner of his clothes.
Chen Wu's palm failed, but he was not discouraged. He immediately changed his move, turned his palm, and swept across Yang Lu's waist!
Yang Lu took half a step back again, barely avoiding it.
Chen Wu continued to attack, one palm after another, and the attacks were continuous like a tide.
His palm skills are calm and sophisticated, and his strength is extremely well controlled. Each palm has just the right amount of force, which can pose a threat to the opponent without exposing any flaws due to excessive force.
The disciples in the audience were very excited: "Okay! Chen Wu presses him down and beats him!"
"Yang Lu can only hide and doesn't dare to take the attack!"
"Yes, yes, that's it, force him to the edge of the ring!"
However, the real situation in the arena was completely different from what the onlookers saw.
The more Chen Wu attacked, the more horrified he became.
He has slapped more than thirty times in a row, each one using the mountain-breaking palm technique that he is good at. The strength, angle, and timing are all just right. But no matter how he hit, Yang Lu could always dodge at the last moment. His movement was as light as a fallen leaf. He was just a little bit close to hitting, but he was always just a little short.
This feeling is like chasing a shadow that you can never catch up with.
What shocked Chen Wu even more was that Yang Lu never attacked from the beginning to the end, but simply dodged.
title_en: Chapter 16: Defeat the enemy with one move and the whole crowd is in an uproar. Chapter 15: You don’t even know what possibility means.
